# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 06, Serye ng 2023 — Prescribing Rules on the Use of Government Ambulance

## Summary

This ordinance prescribes additional regulations on the use of the municipal government ambulance. It complements [[MO-02-S2023]], which covers rescue ambulances, by providing a more specific set of rules governing the deployment and use of the government ambulance unit. The ordinance invokes [[Sec-16-RA7160]] (General Welfare Clause) as its primary legal basis.

## Key Provisions

- Establishes rules and protocols for the proper use of the government ambulance.
- Defines authorized purposes, priority patients, and conditions for ambulance deployment.
- Sets operational guidelines for ambulance drivers and medical personnel.
- Complements the earlier rescue ambulance ordinance ([[MO-02-S2023]]) with additional specific rules.
- Cites the general welfare powers under [[Sec-16-RA7160]].

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General Welfare Clause, empowering LGUs to enact measures for the health, safety, and general welfare of constituents.
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, and functions of the Sangguniang Bayan.
